name: Extender for WooCommerce – Variation Swatches, Product Addons, Product Input Fields, Product Fees
author: Gaurav Kumar

sections.description:
Extender for WooCommerce is the ultimate WooCommerce customization toolkit.
With over 100+ customization features, it allows you to transform your WooCommerce store without writing a single line of code.

From simple tweaks like changing the “Add to Cart” button label to advanced features like variation swatches, product addons, and conditional fees — Extender makes WooCommerce flexible, powerful, and user-friendly.

Whether you’re a store owner, freelancer, or agency, this plugin helps you deliver customized eCommerce experiences faster.

🚀 Key Highlights

  • 100+ WooCommerce customization options (new features added weekly).
  • Lightweight and optimized for speed.
  • No coding required – user-friendly admin settings.
  • Fully compatible with popular WooCommerce themes and plugins.
  • Ideal for beginners, developers, and agencies.

✅ Popular Features

  • Product Addons – Offer gift wrapping, warranty, or upsell items as add-ons.
  • Product Fees – Add extra fees based on product, category, or cart rules.
  • Variation Swatches – Replace dropdowns with color, image, or label swatches.
  • Product Input Fields – Add text, number, date, file upload, or custom fields.

And much more — with new WooCommerce extensions released every week inside the plugin.

Why Choose Extender for WooCommerce?

  • All-in-one WooCommerce customization plugin.
  • Covers products, cart, checkout, and pricing customizations.
  • Saves time and eliminates need for multiple plugins.
  • Perfect for growing WooCommerce stores, agencies, and freelancers.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No. Extender for WooCommerce is beginner-friendly — all customizations can be set up via the admin panel.

Will this plugin slow down my store?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads active features.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes. Extender works seamlessly with all WooCommerce-compatible themes including Astra, Flatsome, Storefront, Divi, and Elementor-based shops.

How many features does this plugin include?

Currently Product Addons, Product Fees, Variation Swatches, Comming up 100+ WooCommerce customization features, and we add new ones weekly.

Can I request a new feature?

Yes! We welcome feature requests from our community. Please open a support thread or connect via the plugin website.
